title: Future Perfect
intro: Future perfect: will have + past participle. Untuk kegiatan yang akan sudah selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan. By Friday I will have finished the book.

exercises.question: By Friday I ___ the book.
exercises.explanation: Rumusnya will have + past participle: will have finished.

exercises.question: She ___ the letter by tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Will have + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari write adalah written, dan will have tidak pernah menjadi will has.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future perfect
exercises.explanation: Will have + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari eat adalah eaten.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the future perfect
exercises.explanation: Will have + past participle. 'Learn' beraturan, jadi learned.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: We will have left by then
exercises.explanation: Subjek + will have + past participle + keterangan waktu.

exercises.prompt: Match each verb to its past participle
exercises.explanation: Past participle dipakai setelah will have: make jadi made, come tetap come, buy jadi bought, win jadi won.

exercises.question: Pick the correct future perfect sentence.
options: They will have gone by six.
They will have went by six.
They will has gone by six.
exercises.answer: They will have gone by six.
exercises.explanation: Will have + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari go adalah gone.

exercises.modelAnswer: I will have finished this course by next week.
